sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुरशीतितमः सर्गः ।। ८४ ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe caturaśītitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 84 ।।

translations.english: 'For that bull among rakshasas, his rite complete, becomes invisible in battle even to the gods and asuras; and should he give battle with his rite accomplished, even the gods would stand in great peril.'
translations.hindi: चाहे अन्न से, चाहे गदा से, चाहे हाथापाई से, जिसमें तुके लड़ने का अभ्यास हो उससे निपट ले
